description: Fix the stale 'Default: 5 000.' idleTimeoutMs JSDoc in the three thin-proxy commands to name IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (30 000 ms).

userStories.title: Correct stale idleTimeoutMs default JSDoc in the three thin-proxy commands
userStories.description: As a cam CLI user reading command help, I need the idleTimeoutMs JSDoc to state the real idle-wait deadline so I do not see a 6x-wrong 5 000 ms when the effective default is 30 000 ms.
acceptanceCriteria: The idleTimeoutMs field JSDoc in src/commands/issue.ts, src/commands/review.ts, and src/commands/spec.ts no longer contains the stale literal 'Default: 5 000.'. [oracle: ! grep -rq 'Default: 5 000' src/commands/issue.ts src/commands/review.ts src/commands/spec.ts]

Each of those three idleTimeoutMs JSDoc blocks documents the real effective default by naming the runtime constant IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (currently 30 000 ms), matching the dispatch.ts JSDoc convention rather than freezing a bare number. [oracle: for f in src/commands/issue.ts src/commands/review.ts src/commands/spec.ts; do grep -q 'IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS' "$f" || exit 1; done]

The sibling logEvent 'Default: the real event log' line and every other unrelated 'Default:' JSDoc in those files are left untouched (surgical, only the idleTimeoutMs 'Default:' line changes). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass with no test-count delta, since only documentation changed (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/issue.ts:83, src/commands/review.ts:82, src/commands/spec.ts:117 (the 'Default: 5 000.' line inside the idleTimeoutMs JSDoc block; the field is declared on the next-but-one line as `idleTimeoutMs?: number;`). Reference the exact wording pattern from src/tmux/dispatch.ts:174 ('Default: `IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS` (see below).') and the value comes from src/tmux/dispatch.ts:288 (`export const IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS = 30_000;`). Grep for '5 000' with a space thousands-separator, not '5000'. Do NOT touch the adjacent logEvent 'Default:' line, and spec.ts has several unrelated injectable-seam 'Default:' lines that must stay untouched. derive-don't-freeze (patterns.md): name the constant and put '(30 000 ms)' in parens for the human reader, as dispatch.ts already does. Comment-only change in CLI command files (NOT sidecar-executed loop code): no coherence rebuild required, no runtime behavior to probe.
